status: Engineering stress hypotheses; not fitted human behaviour
age_policy: Adult Gen Z 18+ and older-adult 50+ labels can be crossed with all six behaviours using identical parameters. Age never determines skill, price, difficulty, failure, spending or help availability.
source_usage: Sources justify coverage dimensions only. No source measures Luma Drift errors, help thresholds, tutorial completion, level duration or retention.

parameter_semantics.off_plan_rate: Assumed probability of selecting an available legal action outside the solver plan. It is not a measured mis-tap or psychological error rate.
parameter_semantics.blocked_probe_rate: Assumed deliberate or accidental blocked-action probe per selection opportunity.
parameter_semantics.help_after_unproductive_actions: Assumed engineering threshold for consulting visible help or a free undo; not a measured reaction time.
parameter_semantics.session_window_minutes: Synthetic interruption budget. Timing must be labelled modelled and cannot establish human enjoyment or next-day return.
parameter_semantics.action_latency_seconds: Synthetic sensitivity interval; includes assumed thinking time and cannot be attributed to any generation.
parameter_semantics.retry_limit: Test-run stopping rule per level, not estimated human churn. Zero retry does not imply loss of progress or resource.
parameter_semantics.no_purchase: All profiles complete without ads or payment. Commerce qualification remains a separate test.

profiles.label: Puzzle newcomer who completes and reopens practice
profiles.design_hypothesis: Teach each mechanic through action and expose a free recovery path.

profiles.label: Experienced phone user, unfamiliar puzzle, skips practice
profiles.design_hypothesis: Digital confidence must not substitute for understanding gates, keys or reversibility.

profiles.label: Reads explanations and checks previews before commitment
profiles.design_hypothesis: Preview and state explanation should reward deliberate play without time pressure.

profiles.label: Short windows, interruption mid-lesson or mid-level
profiles.design_hypothesis: Saving, free exit and return context must survive interruptions.
profiles.note: The 2–5 minute window is a stress choice; no cited survey estimates this window for new Luma players.

profiles.label: Practised puzzle player seeking efficient solutions
profiles.design_hypothesis: Measure monotony, structural variety and meaningful gates even when the path is understood.

profiles.label: Explores clothing and friends between level bursts
profiles.design_hypothesis: Owned items, earned rewards and voluntary social entry should remain clear without pressuring a purchase.
profiles.note: Friend and wardrobe visits are coverage scenarios, not a Gen Z stereotype or predicted feature conversion.
